headline:
Fullscreen
Live Chat
prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. One finished Chrome Web Store promotional tile: exactly LANDSCAPE 11:7 canvas, preferred1760x1120, aspect1.571, no panorama. Attached actual screenshot is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for YouTube native live chat anatomy. Do NOT reuse game, creator, usernames, comments or badges. Concept03 LIGHT EDITORIAL. Calm minimal white paperlike background with black sophisticated large modern sans text. TWO big words/lines at upper-left EXACTLY 'Fullscreen' and 'Live Chat'. Fullscreen must be one word, spelled F-u-l-l-s-c-r-e-e-n. One small red live dot to right of headline, plenty of whitespace, refined YouTube-like product clarity, not SaaS dashboard. Bottom60% of canvas contains one original wide16:9 daytime OUTDOOR MUSIC LIVESTREAM scene: a fictional small indie acoustic musician with guitar on open grass amphitheater beside trees, sun, cheerful tiny distant audience, cinematic real-looking daylight, no known performer. The music scene continues behind a LIGHT THEME native YouTube chat pane OVERLAID INSIDE video on right third, leaving visible video above/below and around pane, not a sidebar outsidevideo. White/lightgray flat chat pane, subtle thin grayborder. Header 'Top chat' black, tinychevron and 3verticaldots. 7 COMPACT chatrows, smallcircleavatars, mutedgray @username and DARKcomment inline on SAME row: @alex love this song; @mira hello chat; @sam sounds great; @jo let's go!; @ren beautiful; @ivy 👏; @kai so good. Never messagebubbles/cards, never rectangular placeholderbars. Footer ownsmallavatar thenunderlined input 'Chat...', tinysmiley and small outlined sendtriangle. This is native YouTube chat with readable natural text rather than generic Messenger. The source video cleanly bounded rectangle thinblackedge, no perspective, no phone/laptop/chromeframe. No promotional buttons/badges/extra copy, no creatorlogos/no endorsement, no neon/rave. Maintain veryclear big words andstrongcontrast when downscaled440x280. Entiretile exactly11:7, not overlywide.
conceptNote: 白黒のタイポグラフィと日中の屋外音楽配信。ライトテーマのYouTube風チャットを映像に重ねる。
